Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Note: Only Designer Approved source are eligible to participate in tender. 1.(a) Only Designer approved sources are eligible to participate in the tender. Quotations received from ot her than approved vendors will not be considered and rejected. (b)Pre-bid meeting for the subject item is to be conducted. 2.(a) The PYRO CARTRIDGE 25DQ is to be manufactured & Supplied by the vendor as per Technical specifi cations (TS) & Qualification Test Plan (QTP)for Pyro Cartridge, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-ASL/HN/Pyro_C/0 1, Rev0. (b)The required input material /Raw material is under vendor scope. Vendor should carry out all the raw m aterial testing's as per specification. 3. All the components should be free from burrs, defects, damages et c. 4. Inspection agency: (a) Inspection agency is MSQAA and/or their nominated inspection agency. (b) All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports of the items cleared by t he inspection agency. (c) Inspection will be carried out at manufacturer's/Vendor's place. (d)Vendor shall inform BDL and MSQAA at various stages, prior One Week to review/witness and give clear ance for further processing. (e) The items shall be dispatched to BDL only after pre-dispatch inspection (PDI) by BDL/ Green Card of MS QAA/their nominated inspection agency (f)Final acceptance will be given after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with I-Note/Green Card of M SQAA or their nominated inspection agency 5. All documents /drawings supplied along with this tender are the property of DRDO and 100% IPR is held with DRDO. These documents/drawings shall not be used for any other purpose, not to be disclosed, copie d and revised in any form without the permission of RCI (DRDO). 6. Delivery Term: Total order shall be delivered at BDL stores and free delivery to BDL (F.O.R. BDL, Kancha nbagh, Hyderabad). 7. Delivery schedule:-Total Order Quantities shall be supplied in 04 months from the date of placement of MSQAA vetted PO.

8. Replacement for the rejected items shall be provided on Priority basis at free of cost by the supplier. 9.(a) All the Items shall be marked by engraving/labeling/ providing tag to ensure identification of compon ent/ heat cycle during and after fabrication. (b) Marking shall be done as per specification at the location marked/shown as in the drawing. For other co mponents, don’t have engraving/Marking location, shall be tagged/labeled with their identification number. 10. Complete inspection and documentation shall be carried out and maintained by the manufacturer as p er drawings and specifications. 11. Packing & Forwarding: (a) Items should be securely packed as per standard specification / guidelines/ TSQD for severe road / rail / air / sea transport conditions and the packing charges borne by the supplier. (b) Freight, Transit Insurance etc., is in supplier scope and at their cost. 12. Payment terms: 100% Payment within 30 days after receipt & acceptance of material at BDL stores. 13. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of p enalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Includi ng duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof , subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be born e by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 14. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail (c) QT & AT should be carried out as per specification, which is under vendor scope. (d) Inspection / test facility: No inspection / test facility will be provided by BDL. All the fixtures, Jigs, tools & Equipment necessary for Fabrication/Inspection/Testing/ is under vendor scope. (e)Total order quantity 151 nos are including QT samples.(b) Benefit of reduction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Contract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. "Certified that the benefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately pas sed on in terms of section 171 of the CGST Act." 15. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Or der / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 16. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 17. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. 18. In case of non-conformity product, supplier has to inform BDL for further disposition action (i.e.re-work, rejection etc.). 19. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . 20. It may be noted whenever special conditions are listed above the same supersedes the conditions men tioned in General/Limited Terms & Conditions. . 2.
